findings_qualitative.value: Brightness temperature increases with distance from the central engine; data are inconsistent with a standard conical BK jet

evidence.quote: properties of AGN jet sources constrained by the VLBI observations at 15-230 GHz are incompatible with the standard BK model

claims.hypothesis: Do 230 GHz-to-2 GHz core properties agree with the BK model?
claims.experiment: Power-law fits of core size, flux and Tb vs frequency for 16 AGN
claims.finding: BK model with constant Lorentz factor and energy partition is incompatible

evidence.quote: Our observations spanning event horizon- to parsec scales indicate a deviation from the standard BK model

claims.experiment: Doppler factor and energy partition scaling
claims.finding: Jet acceleration and/or magnetic energy conversion required

evidence.quote: Either bulk acceleration of the jet material, energy transfer from the magnetic field to the particles, or both are required to explain the observations.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Parabolic-to-conical transition and steeper B(r) profile considered but not fully reconciling

evidence.quote: However, this predominantly shows the inconsistency of the canonical BK model with the data.

limitations_admitted.value: Sparse uv-coverage causes large systematic uncertainties on core size and flux

evidence.quote: Both core size and core flux density parameters are generally subject to significant systematic uncertainties, related to the sparse $(u,v)$–coverage.
